Read a pre-processed feature table for MS1Match

Source: R/read_feature_table.R
read_feature_table.Rd

Imports a feature table from any software (CSV file or data.frame) into the format MS1Match uses: feature_name, mzmed, rtmed (seconds), intensity_mean, intensity_median, followed by one column per sample. A group / cluster column is not required. Any other columns (e.g. such a group index) are kept unchanged.

Usage

read_feature_table(
  x,
  mz_col = "mz",
  rt_col = "rt",
  rt_unit = c("sec", "min"),
  sample_cols,
  id_col = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Path to a CSV file, or a data.frame.

mz_col, rt_col

Names of the m/z and RT columns.

rt_unit

Unit of rt_col: "sec" (default) or "min". Converted to seconds.

sample_cols

Per-sample intensity columns: a character vector of column names, or a single regular expression matched against the column names (e.g. "\\.mzML$").

id_col

Optional feature-id column, used as feature_name. Plain numbers (1, 2, ...) are converted to FT0001, FT0002, ... other ids are kept as they are. If NULL, ids FT0001, ... are assigned after sorting by RT then m/z.

Value

data.frame, one row per retained feature.
